text: Bitcoin's modest 1% gain contrasts with Ethereum's stronger 2% performance, suggesting investors are rotating toward altcoins and smart contract platforms despite Bitcoin's continued dominance at 59.5%. The Fear & Greed Index sitting at 55 (Greed) with a slight 7-day decline indicates cautious optimism rather than euphoria, supported by solid $82B in 24-hour volume showing sustained participation. The broader market's consistent small gains across major assets points to a steady accumulation phase without panic or excessive speculation.
